GAP ANALYSIS ADDENDUM:

G1 - Add test case: test_cited_lines_3part_format_normalized
Defense record may store cited_lines in 3-part format 'path:lineno:content' (from defense_store_write).
_parse_cited_line uses rpartition(':') — fails on 3-part, returns None.
Test: defense cited_lines=['runner.py:42:some def foo():'], finding cited_lines=['runner.py:44'] → must still match (±5).
T4 must normalize 3-part to 2-part before calling compute_proximity_overlap.

G2 - Add test case: test_exact_match_suppressed
DD6 requires exact-match coverage. Add: finding cited_lines=['auth.py:100'], defense cited_lines=['auth.py:100'] (delta=0) → suppressed.

G3 - Explicit acceptance note:
test_legacy_fallback_description_prefix_when_no_cited_lines must assert result[i]['severity'] == 'suggestion' AND '_suppressed_reason' in result[i]
